name: Conventional
description: A plain, conventional part: one fillet radius on outer edges and plan-view corners, a small chamfer only where the part sits on the bed, no signature pattern, fasteners where they fall, engraved text as written, butt-jointed halves, no marks, and colors as the material comes.

notes.edge.chamfer.bottom: Even a conventional printed part keeps its bed edge printable; 0.4 mm is an assumption, and the DFM floor wins when larger.
